# YouTube-Thumbnail-Link-Cleaner

Strip tracking params from YouTube video thumbnail links so drag-and-drop bookmarks save clean URLs

**[Install](https://github.com/MrBurrBurr/YouTube-Thumbnail-Link-Cleaner/raw/main/code.user.js)**
<sub><sup>*(Violentmonkey or Tampermonkey is required to install)*</sup></sub>
